The '''Black Bantha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Black Bantha Nebula/Legends|Black Bantha Nebula]].
